goal: Independently review the Phase 3B/3C art-to-implementation handoff package for CSV reviewability, asset-to-candidate mapping, individual file availability, implementation assessment coverage, and scope preservation before any asset prep or Godot import work.
forbidden_changes: asset import, transparent sprite generation, crop cleanup, Godot scene mutation, Godot script mutation, project.godot mutation
final art direction, style bible, production asset approval, or public-release asset usage
movement changes, collision changes, HUD implementation, enemy, item, scoring, camera, web export, or gameplay expansion
Working, Canonical, or Policy Learning Card promotion

verify.name: CSV and JSON source records parse
verify.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import csv, json
for path in ['art_candidates/phase3b/asset_requirements.csv','art_candidates/phase3b/asset_manifest.csv']:
    with open(path, newline='') as f:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
    assert rows and 'required_asset_id' in rows[0], path
for path in ['art_candidates/phase3b/asset_requirements.json','art_candidates/phase3b/asset_manifest.json']:
    json.load(open(path))
print('records ok')
PY

verify.name: Only authorized QA artifacts changed
verify.command: bash -lc 'extra=$(git status --short --untracked-files=all | sed "s/^...//" | grep -Ev "^(art_notes/AN-2026W22-003-art-production-capability-boundary.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-018.json|runs/RUN-20260531-001.json|art_candidates/phase3b/.*|art_notes/AN-2026W22-004-art-production-candidate-report.md|owner_reviews/OR-2026W22-003-phase3b-art-candidates-KR.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-019.json|runs/RUN-20260531-002.json|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-020.json|runs/RUN-20260531-003.json|implementation_notes/IN-2026W22-001-phase3c-asset-integration-assessment.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-021.json|runs/RUN-20260531-004.json|reviews/RV-20260531-001.json|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-022.json|runs/RUN-20260531-005.json)$" || true); test -z "$extra"'

acceptance_criteria: QA independently reviews the Phase 3B and Phase 3C handoff package without modifying art, implementation, owner review, or Godot files.
QA confirms the CSV review surfaces are parseable and suitable as human-readable asset review tables for this prototype slice.
QA confirms every required asset maps to a candidate id and individual candidate file.
QA confirms the implementation assessment covers target mapping, import prep needs, visual/collision alignment risk, gameplay scope risk, and next Work Package options.
QA confirms the package does not authorize Godot import, transparent sprite generation, production art approval, or gameplay expansion.
QA records pass, rework, or blocked in reviews/RV-20260531-001.json with actionable issues if needed.
No Godot files, asset files, implementation notes, owner reviews, schemas, agent profiles, or Learning Cards are changed by QA.
notes: This Work Package authorizes QA review only. If QA finds defects, it must record rework issues instead of editing the art or implementation package.
